# Host surfaces (fixture)

### HS-01 Widget content stays in the frame body

Widget content is drawn only inside the frame's body.

Check: hostile case: a widget larger than its frame.
Feature: Moldura do host em cada widget com nome e ícone do plugin

### HS-02 A host dialog covers the chrome

A host dialog covers the chrome and every frame.

Check: test: the dialog's layer is above the chrome.
Feature: Diálogo de instalação com permissões em linguagem clara

### HS-03 The frame's header reads as the host's

The header is drawn by the host.

Check: review: the frame feature's review compares the header with the design.
Feature: Moldura do host em cada widget com nome e ícone do plugin
